Myth: a breaker that keeps tripping is broken.

Usually it's doing its job. Something on that circuit is overloaded or faulty.

Never swap in a bigger breaker to silence it.

Find the cause. Or call someone who will.

drafts.text:
Why kitchen outlets look different ⚡

Those with the TEST and RESET buttons are GFCI.

They cut power if current leaks through water or a person.

Required near sinks, baths, garages, outdoors.

If TEST doesn't click off, call a licensed electrician.

drafts.video_tip: Close-up of pressing TEST on a kitchen GFCI so it clicks off, then RESET. 5 seconds, vertical, no music.
